ownership.fundingNotes: Founded in 2015. Revenue from digital advertising and subscriptions. Center-right liberal editorial line with international perspective.

justification.es: Identificacion de fuentes aceptable. Las columnas de opinion superan al contenido informativo con fuentes.
justification.en: Acceptable source identification. Opinion columns exceed news content with sources.

justification.es: Diversidad moderada. Predominan analistas liberales y conservadores. Voces progresistas minoritarias.
justification.en: Moderate diversity. Liberal and conservative analysts predominate. Minority progressive voices.

justification.es: Buen uso de enlaces como medio digital.
justification.en: Good link usage as digital outlet.

justification.es: Documentacion adjunta moderada. Enfoque mas analitico que documental.
justification.en: Moderate attached documentation. More analytical than documentary focus.

justification.es: Datos e infografias de calidad aceptable.
justification.en: Acceptable quality data and infographics.

justification.es: Politica de correcciones existente pero poco visible.
justification.en: Corrections policy exists but not very visible.

justification.es: Ratio de errores moderada.
justification.en: Moderate error ratio.

justification.es: Rectificacion moderada.
justification.en: Moderate rectification.

justification.es: Titulares generalmente alineados con contenido. Menor clickbait que competidores.
justification.en: Headlines generally aligned with content. Less clickbait than competitors.

justification.es: Marcas temporales presentes.
justification.en: Timestamps present.

justification.es: Material multimedia profesional.
justification.en: Professional multimedia material.

justification.es: Buena seleccion de columnistas internacionales. Sesgo liberal.
justification.en: Good selection of international columnists. Liberal bias.

justification.es: Articulos y columnas firmados.
justification.en: Signed articles and columns.

justification.es: Sin Defensor del Lector formal.
justification.en: No formal Reader's Ombudsman.

justification.es: Contenido patrocinado etiquetado.
justification.en: Labeled sponsored content.

justification.es: Sin politica publica sobre IA.
justification.en: No public AI policy.

justification.es: Carga adjetival moderada. Tono analitico liberal predominante.
justification.en: Moderate adjectival load. Predominant liberal analytical tone.

justification.es: Verbos con asimetria moderada liberal-conservadora.
justification.en: Verbs with moderate liberal-conservative asymmetry.

justification.es: Seccion de opinion diferenciada pero el enfoque editorial liberal permea las noticias.
justification.en: Differentiated opinion section but liberal editorial focus permeates news.

justification.es: Sesgo liberal-conservador en seleccion de temas. Mayor cobertura critica del Gobierno.
justification.en: Liberal-conservative bias in topic selection. Greater critical Government coverage.

justification.es: Asimetria editorial moderada. Mayor escrutinio al Gobierno.
justification.en: Moderate editorial asymmetry. Greater Government scrutiny.

justification.es: Encuadre narrativo liberal-conservador. Las politicas del Gobierno de coalicion se enmarcan desde la critica liberal.
justification.en: Liberal-conservative narrative framing. Coalition Government policies framed from liberal criticism.

justification.es: Tratamiento de encuestas con sesgo centro-derecha.
justification.en: Center-right poll treatment bias.

justification.es: Seleccion visual profesional con asimetria leve.
justification.en: Professional visual selection with slight asymmetry.

justification.es: Propiedad del fundador conocida. Estructura menos transparente.
justification.en: Founder ownership known. Structure less transparent.

justification.es: Recibe publicidad institucional. Proporcion no publica.
justification.en: Receives institutional advertising. Proportion not public.

justification.es: Potenciales conflictos por relacion entre inversores y linea editorial.
justification.en: Potential conflicts from investor and editorial line relationship.
